title_en: Also measured, first round: three VVOB training videos
text_en: Before the classroom recording above, Rumi's coaching was measured on three of VVOB's isiZulu training videos (phonics, vocabulary, shared reading). They stay on the Listening review page with the rest of VVOB's recordings.
On those three, Rumi quoted the classroom accurately (72 of 74 quotes found in the transcript), covered 42 of 45 report items with evidence, and gave nearly the same result on three independent runs.
Those lessons are rehearsed demonstrations, which flatter the lesson: on real, unrehearsed isiZulu lessons the same instrument found far fewer lesson steps in place, so it can tell the two apart.
